role.zh: OpenAI 递归自我改进研究

why.en: Former head of OpenAI safety systems. Lil'Log — her systematic write-ups of diffusion models, agents and reinforcement learning — is the standard entry reference for researchers worldwide.
why.zh: 前 OpenAI 安全系统负责人。Lil'Log 对扩散模型、Agent、强化学习的系统梳理，是全球研究者的标准入门参考。

title.en: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement
title.zh: 面向自我改进的 Harness 工程

note.en: Traces recursive self-improvement back to I. J. Good (1965) and works through how an AI uses its intelligence to improve the machinery that produces its intelligence.
note.zh: 把递归自我改进追溯到 I. J. Good（1965），并推演 AI 如何用自身智能改进产生其智能的机制。

title.en: Lil'Log — June 2026 post
title.zh: Lil'Log —— 2026 年 6 月文章

title.en: It is a hard and sad decision. I shared this message with folks at Thinky. Thank you all for the time together♥️ Just as the last sentence in my message: The fu
title.zh: It is a hard and sad decision. I shared this message with folks at Thinky. Thank you all for the time together♥️ Just as the last sentence in my message: The fu

note.en: Weng announced she is leaving Thinking Machines Lab, the startup she joined after OpenAI, writing that "the future worth building is human."
note.zh: 翁荔宣布离开她在OpenAI之后加入的创业公司Thinking Machines Lab，并写道“值得建设的未来是属于人类的”。

title.en: Inkling is our open weights model. It aims to serve as a foundation with solid performance across a broad categories of capabilities, for use in practice and cu
title.zh: Inkling is our open weights model. It aims to serve as a foundation with solid performance across a broad categories of capabilities, for use in practice and cu

note.en: Weng announced Inkling, an open-weights foundation model from Thinking Machines Lab available to try on their Tinker platform.
note.zh: 翁荔宣布推出Inkling，这是Thinking Machines Lab发布的开放权重基础模型，可在其Tinker平台上试用。

title.en: new post on harness engineering for AI self-improvement: https://t.co/ZYvGfVs61k It is hard to forecast how much the future of RSI will rely on harnesses. Likel
title.zh: new post on harness engineering for AI self-improvement: https://t.co/ZYvGfVs61k It is hard to forecast how much the future of RSI will rely on harnesses. Likel

note.en: Weng published a new essay on harness engineering for AI self-improvement, exploring how much recursive self-improvement will depend on the surrounding tooling.
note.zh: 翁荔发表新文章，探讨AI自我改进的“harness”工程，思考递归自我改进在多大程度上依赖于周边工具链。

title.en: A super long overdue (3+ years?) post on scaling laws. Compute is expensive. Scaling laws are a way to help us reason about the optimal compute allocation betwe
title.zh: A super long overdue (3+ years?) post on scaling laws. Compute is expensive. Scaling laws are a way to help us reason about the optimal compute allocation betwe

note.en: Weng published a long-overdue post on scaling laws, reasoning about how to allocate compute optimally between data and model size.
note.zh: 翁荔发表了一篇拖延已久的关于scaling law的长文，讨论如何在数据和模型规模之间最优分配算力。

title.en: Scaling Laws, Carefully
title.zh: Scaling Laws, Carefully

note.en: Lil'Log post examining how reliable neural scaling laws actually are and where the standard loss-versus-compute fits break down.
note.zh: Lil'Log 文章，考察神经网络缩放定律究竟有多可靠，以及常用的损失—算力拟合会在哪些地方失效。

title.en: In the past few months, we had a lot of fun (and stress 😅) to produce 12 versions (+ many subversions) and 137 pages in our training run log book. Turns out hum
title.zh: In the past few months, we had a lot of fun (and stress 😅) to produce 12 versions (+ many subversions) and 137 pages in our training run log book. Turns out hum

note.en: Weng described producing 12 versions and 137 pages of internal training-run logs, noting that human-to-human collaboration mattered as much as the technical work.
note.zh: 翁荔描述团队制作了12个版本、137页的内部训练日志，并指出人与人之间的协作和技术工作同样重要。

title.en: On-policy distillation provides an elegant way to use the teacher model as a process reward model to provide dense reward while preventing SFT style "OOD shock"
title.zh: On-policy distillation provides an elegant way to use the teacher model as a process reward model to provide dense reward while preventing SFT style "OOD shock"

note.en: Weng explained on-policy distillation, describing it as an elegant way to use a teacher model as a process reward model that avoids the "OOD shock" of standard SFT.
note.zh: 翁荔解释了on-policy distillation方法，认为这是一种用教师模型充当过程奖励模型、从而避免标准SFT“分布外冲击”问题的巧妙方式。

title.en: GPUs are expensive and setting up the infrastructure to make GPUs work for you properly is complex, making experimentation on cutting-edge models challenging fo
title.zh: GPUs are expensive and setting up the infrastructure to make GPUs work for you properly is complex, making experimentation on cutting-edge models challenging fo

note.en: Weng discussed the cost and complexity of GPU infrastructure for experimentation, pointing to work making cutting-edge model access easier for researchers.
note.zh: 翁荔谈到GPU基础设施对实验而言成本高、搭建复杂，并介绍了让研究人员更容易使用前沿模型的相关工作。

title.en: Besides the fun fact that Connectionism is connected with the early days of the AI field and highlights similarities between neural networks and human brains, t
title.zh: Besides the fun fact that Connectionism is connected with the early days of the AI field and highlights similarities between neural networks and human brains, t

note.en: Weng explained why Thinking Machines Lab named its blog "Connectionism," tying it to the field's early history and the analogy between neural networks and the brain.
note.zh: 翁荔解释了Thinking Machines Lab将其博客命名为“Connectionism”的原因，将其与AI早期历史以及神经网络与大脑的类比联系起来。

title.en: I still find it mysterious whether and how intelligence and capabilities transfer between domains and skills - from meta learning during early days to more rece
title.zh: I still find it mysterious whether and how intelligence and capabilities transfer between domains and skills - from meta learning during early days to more rece

note.en: Weng reflected on the open research question of how intelligence and capabilities transfer across domains, from early meta-learning work to whether solving math helps other skills.
note.zh: 翁荔思考了智能与能力如何跨领域迁移这一悬而未决的问题，从早期的元学习研究到解数学题是否有助于其他能力。

title.en: Giving your models more time to think before prediction, like via smart decoding, chain-of-thoughts reasoning, latent thoughts, etc, turns out to be quite effec
title.zh: Giving your models more time to think before prediction, like via smart decoding, chain-of-thoughts reasoning, latent thoughts, etc, turns out to be quite effec

note.en: Weng argued that giving models more inference-time compute — via smart decoding, chain-of-thought, or latent thoughts — is proving effective for the next level of intelligence.
note.zh: 翁荔提出，通过智能解码、思维链推理、隐式思考等方式给模型更多推理时思考时间，被证明能有效推动智能的下一个层级。

title.en: Why We Think
title.zh: Why We Think

note.en: Lil'Log survey of test-time compute and chain-of-thought, explaining why letting a model think longer before answering improves reasoning.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述测试时计算与思维链，解释为何让模型在作答前多思考一步能提升推理能力。

title.en: This is something we have been cooking together for a few months and I'm very excited to announce it today. Thinking Machines Lab is my next adventure and I'm f
title.zh: This is something we have been cooking together for a few months and I'm very excited to announce it today. Thinking Machines Lab is my next adventure and I'm f

note.en: Weng announced she is co-founding Thinking Machines Lab, calling it her next adventure after leaving OpenAI.
note.zh: 翁荔宣布联合创立Thinking Machines Lab，称这是她离开OpenAI后的下一段冒险。

title.en: Diverse and Effective Red Teaming with Auto-generated Rewards and Multi-step Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Diverse and Effective Red Teaming with Auto-generated Rewards and Multi-step Reinforcement Learning

note.en: OpenAI paper on automated red teaming that uses auto-generated rewards and multi-step RL to produce attacks that are both diverse and effective.
note.zh: OpenAI 论文，用自动生成的奖励与多步强化学习做自动化红队测试，使生成的攻击兼具多样性与有效性。

title.en: OpenAI o1 System Card
title.zh: OpenAI o1 System Card

note.en: The o1 system card, documenting the safety evaluations and risk assessment for OpenAI's first large-scale reasoning model series.
note.zh: o1 系统卡，记录 OpenAI 首个大规模推理模型系列的安全评估与风险评估。

title.en: 🦃 At the end of Thanksgiving holidays, I finally finished the piece on reward hacking. Not an easy one to write, phew. Reward hacking occurs when an RL agent ex
title.zh: 🦃 At the end of Thanksgiving holidays, I finally finished the piece on reward hacking. Not an easy one to write, phew. Reward hacking occurs when an RL agent ex

note.en: Weng published a piece on reward hacking, explaining how RL agents exploit flaws in reward functions or environments to achieve high reward without the intended behavior.
note.zh: 翁荔发表了一篇关于reward hacking的文章，解释RL智能体如何利用奖励函数或环境中的缺陷，在未达成预期行为的情况下获得高奖励。

title.en: Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Lil'Log post on reward hacking, cataloguing how RL agents exploit flaws in reward functions instead of learning the intended task.
note.zh: Lil'Log 关于奖励作弊的文章，梳理强化学习智能体如何钻奖励函数的漏洞，而非真正学会目标任务。

title.en: After working at OpenAI for almost 7 years, I decide to leave. I learned so much and now I'm ready for a reset and something new. Here is the note I just shared
title.zh: After working at OpenAI for almost 7 years, I decide to leave. I learned so much and now I'm ready for a reset and something new. Here is the note I just shared

note.en: Weng announced she is leaving OpenAI after almost seven years, sharing her farewell note to the team.
note.zh: 翁荔宣布在OpenAI工作近七年后离职，并分享了她写给团队的告别信。

title.en: Rule Based Rewards for Language Model Safety
title.zh: Rule Based Rewards for Language Model Safety

note.en: OpenAI paper introducing rule-based rewards, which encode safety behaviour as explicit rules used as an RL training signal instead of collected human preference data.
note.zh: OpenAI 论文提出基于规则的奖励，把安全行为写成显式规则作为强化学习训练信号，替代收集人类偏好数据。

title.en: GPT-4o System Card
title.zh: GPT-4o System Card

note.en: The GPT-4o system card, covering the capabilities and safety evaluation of OpenAI's end-to-end text, audio, image and video model.
note.zh: GPT-4o 系统卡，介绍 OpenAI 端到端文本、音频、图像与视频模型的能力及安全评估。

title.en: First-Person Fairness in Chatbots
title.zh: First-Person Fairness in Chatbots

note.en: OpenAI study measuring first-person fairness — whether a chatbot's answers differ by the user's own name-inferred identity — across real ChatGPT usage.
note.zh: OpenAI 研究衡量“第一人称公平性”，即聊天机器人的回答是否会因用户姓名所暗示的身份而不同，并在真实 ChatGPT 使用数据上评估。

title.en: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
title.zh: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering

note.en: MLE-bench, an OpenAI benchmark of 75 Kaggle competitions that measures how well AI agents perform end-to-end machine learning engineering.
note.zh: MLE-bench，OpenAI 用 75 场 Kaggle 竞赛构建的基准，衡量 AI 智能体端到端完成机器学习工程任务的能力。

title.en: 🍓 Finally o1 is out - our first model with general reasoning capabilities. Not only it achieves impressive results on hard, scientific tasks, but also it gets s
title.zh: 🍓 Finally o1 is out - our first model with general reasoning capabilities. Not only it achieves impressive results on hard, scientific tasks, but also it gets s

note.en: Weng announced the release of o1, OpenAI's first model with general reasoning capabilities, noting gains on hard scientific tasks and safety robustness.
note.zh: 翁荔宣布OpenAI首款具备通用推理能力的模型o1发布，指出该模型在高难度科学任务和安全鲁棒性方面均有提升。

title.en: Iterative deployment for maximizing AI safety learning needs to be built on top of rigorous science and process. We are learning and improving through each laun
title.zh: Iterative deployment for maximizing AI safety learning needs to be built on top of rigorous science and process. We are learning and improving through each laun

note.en: Weng argued that safely deploying AI iteratively requires building on rigorous science and process, not just learning launch by launch.
note.zh: 翁荔认为，要安全地迭代部署AI，需要建立在严谨的科学方法和流程之上，而不仅仅是靠一次次发布来学习。

title.en: Rule-based rewards (RBRs) use model to provide RL signals based on a set of safety rubrics, making it easier to adapt to changing safety policies wo/ heavy depe
title.zh: Rule-based rewards (RBRs) use model to provide RL signals based on a set of safety rubrics, making it easier to adapt to changing safety policies wo/ heavy depe

note.en: Weng described rule-based rewards (RBRs), a technique using a model to generate RL signals from safety rubrics so safety policies can be updated without heavy new human data collection.
note.zh: 翁荔介绍了基于规则的奖励（RBR）技术：用模型根据安全准则生成强化学习信号，使安全策略无需大量新增人工数据即可更新。

title.en: Wrote about extrinsic hallucinations during the July 4th break. https://t.co/QGsRJVQUHT Here is what ChatGPT suggested as a fun tweet for the blog: 🚀 Dive into
title.zh: Wrote about extrinsic hallucinations during the July 4th break. https://t.co/QGsRJVQUHT Here is what ChatGPT suggested as a fun tweet for the blog: 🚀 Dive into

note.en: Weng published a piece on extrinsic hallucinations, examining why language models generate confident but false statements.
note.zh: 翁荔发表了一篇关于“外在性幻觉”的文章，探讨语言模型为何会生成看似自信却错误的陈述。

title.en: Extrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs
title.zh: Extrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs

note.en: Lil'Log post narrowing hallucination to the extrinsic case — output unsupported by world knowledge — and reviewing how to detect and reduce it.
note.zh: Lil'Log 文章将幻觉聚焦于“外在幻觉”，即与世界知识不符的输出，并综述其检测与缓解方法。

title.en: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
title.zh: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions

note.en: OpenAI paper proposing an instruction hierarchy so models privilege system instructions over untrusted user or tool input, defending against prompt injection and jailbreaks.
note.zh: OpenAI 论文提出指令层级，让模型优先服从系统指令而非不可信的用户或工具输入，以抵御提示注入与越狱。

title.en: 🎨Spent some time refactoring the 2021 post on diffusion model with new content: https://t.co/GkQ5c4jXn2 ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ 🎬Then another short piece on diffusion video mo
title.zh: 🎨Spent some time refactoring the 2021 post on diffusion model with new content: https://t.co/GkQ5c4jXn2 ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ 🎬Then another short piece on diffusion video mo

note.en: Weng refactored her widely read 2021 essay on diffusion models with new content and posted a companion piece on diffusion video models.
note.zh: 翁荔更新了她2021年广受阅读的扩散模型文章并加入新内容，还发布了一篇关于扩散视频模型的配套文章。

title.en: Diffusion Models for Video Generation
title.zh: Diffusion Models for Video Generation

note.en: Lil'Log survey of diffusion models applied to video generation and the extra difficulties of the temporal dimension.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述用于视频生成的扩散模型，以及时间维度带来的额外难题。

title.en: 🗣️I've been thinking about data quality & human factor in the process a lot lately, so write a short post on the topic: https://t.co/onWGvdeGVP More: If you
title.zh: 🗣️I've been thinking about data quality & human factor in the process a lot lately, so write a short post on the topic: https://t.co/onWGvdeGVP More: If you

note.en: Weng published a short post on data quality and the human factors involved in producing it.
note.zh: 翁荔发表了一篇关于数据质量及其背后人为因素的短文。

title.en: Thinking about High-Quality Human Data
title.zh: Thinking about High-Quality Human Data

note.en: Lil'Log post on sourcing high-quality human annotation, covering rater disagreement, wisdom-of-crowds effects and data quality control.
note.zh: Lil'Log 讨论如何获取高质量人工标注，涵盖标注者分歧、群体智慧效应与数据质量控制。

title.en: Adversarial Attacks on LLMs
title.zh: Adversarial Attacks on LLMs

note.en: Lil'Log survey of adversarial attacks on LLMs, from token-level jailbreak search to human red teaming, written from her OpenAI safety work.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述针对大语言模型的对抗攻击，从 token 级越狱搜索到人工红队，源自她在 OpenAI 的安全工作。

title.en: LLM Powered Autonomous Agents
title.zh: LLM Powered Autonomous Agents

note.en: Her most widely cited post, framing LLM agents as planning plus memory plus tool use — the reference decomposition the field still quotes.
note.zh: 她被引用最广的一篇文章，将 LLM 智能体拆解为规划、记忆与工具调用，至今仍是业界沿用的参考框架。

title.en: Prompt Engineering
title.zh: Prompt Engineering

note.en: Lil'Log reference on prompt engineering, collecting in-context prompting methods that steer model behaviour without updating weights.
note.zh: Lil'Log 的提示工程参考文章，汇总在不更新权重的前提下引导模型行为的上下文提示方法。

title.en: GPT-4 Technical Report
title.zh: GPT-4 Technical Report

note.en: The GPT-4 technical report, describing the large multimodal model's capabilities, exam-level performance and safety mitigations.
note.zh: GPT-4 技术报告，介绍这一大型多模态模型的能力、在各类考试上的表现以及安全缓解措施。

title.en: The Transformer Family Version 2.0
title.zh: The Transformer Family Version 2.0

note.en: A full rewrite of her 2020 Transformer survey, adding the architecture variants that appeared in the intervening three years.
note.zh: 对她 2020 年 Transformer 综述的全面重写，补入此后三年出现的各种架构变体。

title.en: Large Transformer Model Inference Optimization
title.zh: Large Transformer Model Inference Optimization

note.en: Lil'Log survey of inference optimisation for large transformers — distillation, quantisation, pruning and sparsity.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述大型 Transformer 的推理优化，涵盖蒸馏、量化、剪枝与稀疏化。

title.en: Some Math behind Neural Tangent Kernel
title.zh: Some Math behind Neural Tangent Kernel

note.en: Lil'Log derivation of the neural tangent kernel, working through the maths of why wide networks behave like kernel regression.
note.zh: Lil'Log 推导神经正切核，逐步讲清为何宽网络的训练行为近似于核回归。

title.en: A Holistic Approach to Undesired Content Detection in the Real World
title.zh: A Holistic Approach to Undesired Content Detection in the Real World

note.en: The paper behind OpenAI's moderation endpoint, describing how the undesired-content classifier was built, trained and evaluated in production.
note.zh: OpenAI 内容审核接口背后的论文，介绍其不良内容分类器在生产环境中的构建、训练与评估方式。

title.en: Generalized Visual Language Models
title.zh: Generalized Visual Language Models

note.en: Lil'Log survey of vision-language models, covering how image encoders are fused with language models for captioning and VQA.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述视觉语言模型，讲解图像编码器如何与语言模型融合以完成图像描述与视觉问答。

title.en: Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Survey
title.zh: Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Survey

note.en: A survey of exploration methods in deep RL, categorising novelty rewards, goal-based, probabilistic, imitation and safe-exploration approaches; she is the OpenAI co-author.
note.zh: 深度强化学习探索方法综述，将新奇性奖励、目标导向、概率、模仿与安全探索等路线分类整理；她是其中来自 OpenAI 的合著者。

title.en: Learning with not Enough Data Part 3: Data Generation
title.zh: Learning with not Enough Data Part 3: Data Generation

note.en: Part 3 of her limited-data series, on generating synthetic and augmented training data.
note.zh: 她“数据不足时怎么办”系列的第三篇，讨论如何生成合成数据与增强数据。

title.en: Learning with not Enough Data Part 2: Active Learning
title.zh: Learning with not Enough Data Part 2: Active Learning

note.en: Part 2 of her limited-data series, on active learning — spending a fixed human labelling budget where it helps most.
note.zh: 她“数据不足时怎么办”系列的第二篇，讲主动学习，即把有限的人工标注预算花在最有价值的样本上。

title.en: Text and Code Embeddings by Contrastive Pre-Training
title.zh: Text and Code Embeddings by Contrastive Pre-Training

note.en: OpenAI paper training general-purpose text and code embeddings by contrastive pre-training.
note.zh: OpenAI 论文，用对比预训练得到通用的文本与代码嵌入。

title.en: Learning with not Enough Data Part 1: Semi-Supervised Learning
title.zh: Learning with not Enough Data Part 1: Semi-Supervised Learning

note.en: Part 1 of her limited-data series, surveying semi-supervised learning approaches for scarce labels.
note.zh: 她“数据不足时怎么办”系列的第一篇，综述标注稀缺场景下的半监督学习方法。

title.en: How to Train Really Large Models on Many GPUs?
title.zh: How to Train Really Large Models on Many GPUs?

note.en: Lil'Log guide to large-model parallelism — data, tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism — and the memory tricks that make them fit.
note.zh: Lil'Log 关于大模型并行训练的指南，涵盖数据、张量、流水线与专家并行，以及配套的显存优化技巧。

title.en: What are Diffusion Models?
title.zh: What are Diffusion Models?

note.en: Her diffusion-model explainer, the write-up most researchers were pointed to when learning the forward and reverse processes.
note.zh: 她的扩散模型讲解文章，是多数研究者初学前向与反向过程时被推荐的入门读物。

title.en: Contrastive Representation Learning
title.zh: Contrastive Representation Learning

note.en: Lil'Log survey of contrastive representation learning, covering the loss functions and negative-sampling designs behind SimCLR-era methods.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述对比表示学习，梳理 SimCLR 时期方法背后的损失函数与负样本采样设计。

title.en: Reducing Toxicity in Language Models
title.zh: Reducing Toxicity in Language Models

note.en: Lil'Log post on measuring and reducing toxic output in language models, an early statement of the safety agenda she later led at OpenAI.
note.zh: Lil'Log 关于衡量与降低语言模型有害输出的文章，是她后来在 OpenAI 主导的安全议题的早期表述。

title.en: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation
title.zh: Asymmetric self-play for automatic goal discovery in robotic manipulation

note.en: OpenAI robotics paper training one goal-conditioned policy across many manipulation tasks via asymmetric self-play between a goal-setter and a solver.
note.zh: OpenAI 机器人论文，通过“出题者—解题者”之间的非对称自博弈，训练出一个可完成多种操作任务的目标条件策略。

title.en: Controllable Neural Text Generation
title.zh: Controllable Neural Text Generation

note.en: Lil'Log survey of controllable text generation, from guided decoding to prompt and prefix tuning.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述可控文本生成，从引导式解码到提示微调与前缀微调。

title.en: How to Build an Open-Domain Question Answering System?
title.zh: How to Build an Open-Domain Question Answering System?

note.en: Lil'Log walkthrough of open-domain question answering, comparing retriever-reader pipelines with closed-book generation.
note.zh: Lil'Log 系统讲解开放域问答，比较“检索器+阅读器”流水线与闭卷生成两条路线。

title.en: Neural Architecture Search
title.zh: Neural Architecture Search

note.en: Lil'Log survey of neural architecture search, covering search spaces, search strategies and one-shot weight-sharing methods.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述神经架构搜索，涵盖搜索空间、搜索策略与权重共享的 one-shot 方法。

title.en: Exploration Strategies in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Exploration Strategies in Deep Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Lil'Log survey of exploration strategies in deep RL, from count-based bonuses to curiosity and disagreement-driven methods.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述深度强化学习中的探索策略，从基于计数的奖励到好奇心驱动与分歧驱动的方法。

title.en: The Transformer Family
title.zh: The Transformer Family

note.en: Her original Transformer family survey, mapping attention variants and long-context architectures as of 2020.
note.zh: 她最初的 Transformer 家族综述，梳理了截至 2020 年的各类注意力变体与长上下文架构。

title.en: Automatic Curriculum Learning For Deep RL: A Short Survey
title.zh: Automatic Curriculum Learning For Deep RL: A Short Survey

note.en: An IJCAI 2020 survey of automatic curriculum learning for deep RL, co-authored with the Inria Flowers group while she was at OpenAI.
note.zh: 发表于 IJCAI 2020 的深度强化学习自动课程学习综述，是她在 OpenAI 期间与 Inria Flowers 团队合作完成的。

title.en: Curriculum for Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Curriculum for Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Lil'Log post on curriculum design for RL, covering task ordering, teacher-student setups and distillation-based curricula.
note.zh: Lil'Log 关于强化学习课程设计的文章，涵盖任务排序、师生框架与基于蒸馏的课程方案。

title.en: Self-Supervised Representation Learning
title.zh: Self-Supervised Representation Learning

note.en: Lil'Log survey of self-supervised representation learning across images, video and language, later extended with the momentum-contrast methods.
note.zh: Lil'Log 综述图像、视频与语言领域的自监督表示学习，后续又补充了动量对比一类方法。

title.en: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand
title.zh: Solving Rubik's Cube with a Robot Hand

note.en: The OpenAI robotics result solving a Rubik's Cube one-handed with a real robot hand trained purely in simulation with automatic domain randomisation.
note.zh: OpenAI 机器人研究成果：完全在仿真中通过自动域随机化训练，让真实机械手单手复原魔方。

title.en: Evolution Strategies
title.zh: Evolution Strategies

note.en: Lil'Log tutorial on evolution strategies as a gradient-free alternative to SGD.
note.zh: Lil'Log 教程，介绍作为 SGD 无梯度替代方案的进化策略。

title.en: ORRB -- OpenAI Remote Rendering Backend
title.zh: ORRB -- OpenAI Remote Rendering Backend

note.en: ORRB, the Unity-based remote rendering backend OpenAI built to generate randomised images for its robotics simulation stack.
note.zh: ORRB，OpenAI 基于 Unity 构建的远程渲染后端，为其机器人仿真流程生成随机化图像。

title.en: Meta Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: Meta Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Lil'Log post extending her meta-learning series to RL, covering how agents can meta-learn to adapt to new tasks.
note.zh: Lil'Log 将元学习系列延伸到强化学习，讲解智能体如何通过元学习快速适应新任务。

title.en: From GAN to WGAN
title.zh: From GAN to WGAN

note.en: Her single-author write-up of the maths behind GAN training instability and how Wasserstein GAN's smoother metric addresses it.
note.zh: 她独著的文章，讲清 GAN 训练不稳定背后的数学原理，以及 Wasserstein GAN 如何用更平滑的度量加以改善。

title.en: Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
title.zh: Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation

note.en: OpenAI's Dactyl paper, using RL and domain randomisation to learn in-hand object reorientation on a physical robot hand.
note.zh: OpenAI 的 Dactyl 论文，用强化学习和域随机化让实体机械手学会手内物体翻转。

title.en: Attention on Weak Ties in Social and Communication Networks
title.zh: Attention on Weak Ties in Social and Communication Networks

note.en: PhD-era work with Menczer and Flammini testing Granovetter's weak-tie theory against interaction data from social and communication networks.
note.zh: 她博士期间与 Menczer、Flammini 合作的研究，用社交与通信网络的互动数据检验 Granovetter 的弱连带理论。

title.en: Predicting Successful Memes using Network and Community Structure
title.zh: Predicting Successful Memes using Network and Community Structure

note.en: ICWSM 2014 paper from her Indiana University PhD predicting which memes spread widely from their early diffusion patterns.
note.zh: 她在印第安纳大学读博期间发表于 ICWSM 2014 的论文，根据早期传播模式预测哪些梗会广泛扩散。

title.en: Topicality and Social Impact: Diverse Messages but Focused Messengers
title.zh: Topicality and Social Impact: Diverse Messages but Focused Messengers

note.en: PhD-era paper with Menczer asking whether Twitter users who post on focused topics gain more influence than generalists.
note.zh: 她博士期间与 Menczer 合作的论文，探讨在 Twitter 上专注于特定话题的用户是否比泛泛而谈者更具影响力。

title.en: Virality Prediction and Community Structure in Social Networks
title.zh: Virality Prediction and Community Structure in Social Networks

note.en: Her most-cited pre-OpenAI paper, showing that community structure in a social network predicts which content goes viral.
note.zh: 她加入 OpenAI 之前被引用最多的论文，表明社交网络的社区结构可以预测哪些内容会病毒式传播。

title.en: The Role of Information Diffusion in the Evolution of Social Networks
title.zh: The Role of Information Diffusion in the Evolution of Social Networks

note.en: PhD-era paper showing that information diffusion, not just triadic closure, drives how social network ties form over time.
note.zh: 她博士期间的论文，指出社交网络连边的形成不仅源于三元闭包，信息传播本身也是重要驱动力。

title.en: Context Visualization for Social Bookmark Management
title.zh: Context Visualization for Social Bookmark Management

note.en: An early Indiana University paper with Menczer presenting GalViz, a visual interface for browsing social bookmarks by context.
note.zh: 她在印第安纳大学与 Menczer 合作的早期论文，提出 GalViz——一个按上下文浏览社会化书签的可视化界面。

body.en: Lilian Weng, OpenAI's former VP of Research and Safety, announced she was stepping down from OpenAI, citing physical exhaustion.
body.zh: OpenAI前研究与安全副总裁翁荔宣布因身体透支离职。

title.en: 翁荔长文谈Harness自进化：Agent越用越强，评测难点怎么破？
title.zh: 翁荔长文谈Harness自进化：Agent越用越强，评测难点怎么破？

body.en: Weng published a long essay on harness self-evolution, arguing agents get stronger with use and discussing why evaluation remains hard.
body.zh: 翁荔发表长文探讨Harness自进化，认为智能体会越用越强，并讨论评测难题为何依然存在。

title.en: 翁荔新博客提出「自进化先从Harness开始」，DeepSeek崔添翼转发附议
title.zh: 翁荔新博客提出「自进化先从Harness开始」，DeepSeek崔添翼转发附议

body.en: Lilian Weng published a new blog post arguing that self-evolution in AI agents should start with the harness, drawing a public repost of agreement from DeepSeek's Cui Tianyi.
body.zh: 翁荔发表新博客，主张AI智能体的自我进化应从Harness入手，DeepSeek的崔添翼转发表示赞同。

title.en: 翁荔新博客提出「自进化先从Harness开始」，DeepSeek崔添翼转发附议- 产业链
title.zh: 翁荔新博客提出「自进化先从Harness开始」，DeepSeek崔添翼转发附议- 产业链

body.en: Weng's new blog post argues that self-evolving AI should start from the harness/scaffolding layer, drawing an approving repost from DeepSeek researcher Cui Tianyi — a research idea gaining traction.
body.zh: 翁荔新博客提出「自进化应从Harness（脚手架层）入手」的观点，获得DeepSeek研究员崔添翼转发附议，显示该研究观点正获得关注。

title.en: 刚刚，翁荔博客上新：谨慎对待Scaling Law
title.zh: 刚刚，翁荔博客上新：谨慎对待Scaling Law

body.en: Weng's blog argued for caution in relying on scaling laws, a technical stance widely read in the open-model research community.
body.zh: 翁荔在博客中提出应谨慎对待Scaling Law（规模定律），这一技术立场在开放模型研究圈内被广泛关注。

title.en: 翁荔拆解Scaling Laws_新浪新闻
title.zh: 翁荔拆解Scaling Laws_新浪新闻

body.en: Lilian Weng published a long-form analysis of scaling laws on her blog after a three-year hiatus, which drew wide attention online.
body.zh: 翁荔时隔三年再更新博客，发表了一篇关于Scaling Laws的长文解读，引发广泛关注。

title.en: 拖更三年，北大校友翁荔最新长文刷屏！
title.zh: 拖更三年，北大校友翁荔最新长文刷屏！

body.en: Lilian Weng published a new long-form essay after roughly three years without a public write-up, and it went viral in Chinese tech media.
body.zh: 翁荔时隔约三年再次发布长文，该文章在中文科技媒体圈引发刷屏式关注。

title.en: 刚刚，翁荔博客上新：谨慎对待Scaling Law
title.zh: 刚刚，翁荔博客上新：谨慎对待Scaling Law

body.en: Weng published a new Lil'Log post urging caution about scaling laws, a notable technical stance from a researcher whose write-ups are widely read.
body.zh: 翁荔在Lil'Log发表新文章，呼吁对Scaling Law保持谨慎态度——这是一位广受关注的研究者给出的值得注意的技术立场。

title.en: 拖更三年！北大校友翁荔最新长文火爆刷屏
title.zh: 拖更三年！北大校友翁荔最新长文火爆刷屏

body.en: After three years without an update, Lilian Weng published a new long-form post on her blog that went viral in China.
body.zh: 翁荔时隔三年更新博客，发布的最新长文在中国社交网络上引发热议。

title.en: 翁荔创业大模型首秀！告别“120亿美元估值0模型”
title.zh: 翁荔创业大模型首秀！告别“120亿美元估值0模型”

body.en: Weng's startup unveiled its first large model, ending months of scrutiny over a $12B valuation with no shipped product.
body.zh: 翁荔创立的公司首次发布其大模型产品，结束了外界对其"120亿美元估值却无产品"的质疑。

title.en: 刚刚，Thinking Machines出手！首款交互模型来了，翁荔出镜实测_手机新浪网
title.zh: 刚刚，Thinking Machines出手！首款交互模型来了，翁荔出镜实测_手机新浪网

body.en: Thinking Machines Lab launched its first interactive model, with Lilian Weng appearing on camera to demo it herself.
body.zh: Thinking Machines Lab发布了首款交互模型，翁荔亲自出镜进行了实测演示。

title.en: 刚刚，Thinking Machines出手！首款交互模型来了，翁荔出镜实测
title.zh: 刚刚，Thinking Machines出手！首款交互模型来了，翁荔出镜实测

body.en: Lilian Weng appeared in a hands-on demo testing Thinking Machines' newly released interactive model.
body.zh: 翁荔出镜参与了Thinking Machines新发布交互模型的实测演示。

title.en: 翁荔创业大模型首秀！告别「120亿美元估值0模型」
title.zh: 翁荔创业大模型首秀！告别「120亿美元估值0模型」

body.en: Thinking Machines Lab, the startup Weng co-founded with Mira Murati, shipped its first model, ending more than a year at a $12B valuation with no public product.
body.zh: 翁荔与Mira Murati共同创立的Thinking Machines Lab发布首个大模型，结束了该公司估值120亿美元却始终没有产品发布的局面。

title.en: 刚刚，Thinking Machines出手！首款交互模型来了，翁荔出镜实测_手机新浪网
title.zh: 刚刚，Thinking Machines出手！首款交互模型来了，翁荔出镜实测_手机新浪网

body.en: Lilian Weng appeared on camera to demo Thinking Machines Lab's first interactive model at its launch.
body.zh: 翁荔在Thinking Machines Lab首款交互模型发布时出镜实测演示。

title.en: Mira翁荔陈丹琦公司：促使老黄掏出600亿美金！
title.zh: Mira翁荔陈丹琦公司：促使老黄掏出600亿美金！

body.en: Reports say the startup co-founded by Mira Murati, Lilian Weng and Danqi Chen drew a $60 billion commitment from Jensen Huang/Nvidia, a sign Weng's primary affiliation has moved beyond OpenAI.
body.zh: 报道称，由Mira Murati、翁荔和陈丹琦共同创立的公司促使黄仁勋／英伟达投入600亿美元，这表明翁荔的主要身份已不再局限于OpenAI。

title.en: Mira翁荔陈丹琦公司，让老黄掏出了600亿美金
title.zh: Mira翁荔陈丹琦公司，让老黄掏出了600亿美金

body.en: Nvidia agreed to invest roughly $60 billion, including a gigawatt-scale data center deal, in Thinking Machines Lab, the startup Lilian Weng had joined alongside Mira Murati and Danqi Chen.
body.zh: 英伟达同意向Thinking Machines Lab投资约600亿美元，包括一项千兆瓦级数据中心协议；翁荔当时与Mira Murati、陈丹琦同在该公司。

title.en: E217. OpenAI模型改进放缓 | 翁荔离职影响安全研究
title.zh: E217. OpenAI模型改进放缓 | 翁荔离职影响安全研究

body.en: Lilian Weng departs OpenAI as head of the safety systems team, a move discussed alongside signs that the company's model improvements are slowing.
body.zh: 翁荔从OpenAI安全系统团队负责人一职离职，该消息与公司模型改进放缓的迹象一并被讨论。

was.zh: Thinking Machines Lab 联合创始人
